title: Talks & Workshops
description: Demystifying AI — what it makes for you, and what it makes at you. Booked one-on-one, as an open cohort, or in-house for a team. Built for people who want something they can apply Monday morning.

faq.q: What topics do your talks and workshops cover?
faq.a: High-stakes software delivery, election systems, and practical AI adoption for teams and schools. Every session is hands-on — people work through real problems in the room.
